name: team_planning_set_unit_succession
description: Say which units carry on from which in a scenario of a Team Planning plan: a split (one predecessor, several successors), a merge (several predecessors, one successor) or a replacement. Every live predecessor retires in the same write. Successors must be live, no unit can succeed itself, and no chain of successions may loop back. Without succession_id it records a new succession; with one it restates it, and a unit the old statement retired stays retired until team_planning_set_unit sets it again. scenario_id defaults to the baseline, whose id is the plan's. Refused unless the caller is one of the plan's editors.

successor_ids.description: live units that carry on from them
